summary: No valid functional-regression plan: this commit only renames ArrayVec::capacity_left to remaining_capacity and updates callers, documentation, and tests. Both revisions compute self.capacity() - self.len(); no runtime behavior changes. The updated test_capacity_left in tests/tests.rs retains the same assertions. Reversing the rename while preserving upstream tests would cause missing-method compilation errors, which cannot satisfy the confirmation gate. No builds or tests were run.
